group_intro: Companion to the seven-model 10,000-path V4 study. This report keeps only Heston and Heston–Merton. In V4 their P dynamics still come from returns (Method A), and listed calls identify the Pan (2002) volatility / jump-size premia used for LSM. Rankings are within this pair; they are not compared here with return-based models.
Companies are SPY, AAPL, MSFT, and AMZN. No new calibration or LSM.
